subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt one of the open fork candidates, or close those candidates and sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but existing no-new-fix-pr state plus conflicting external candidates means automation should pause until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix in this repository, using the closed PRs as context and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh an existing fork candidate
options.body: Pick the best open fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix in this repository, using the closed PRs as context and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path blame and PR history make this the strongest routing candidate for choosing the fix path.
